requirement:
The user should be able to search for a product.

When the user enters a valid product search term, matching products should be displayed.

When the user searches for a product that does not exist, an appropriate no-results message should be displayed.

evidenceSummary: Inspected page "Swag Labs" at https://www.saucedemo.com/; captured 7 visible elements.
Inspected page "Swag Labs" at https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html; captured 71 visible elements.
No search-related elements were reported on the inspected pages. This does not prove the capability is absent elsewhere.

summary: The application inspection of SauceDemo (inventory page and login page) revealed no search-related input controls or functionality, making product search unverified based on current discovery evidence.
missingCapabilities: Product search input and filtering functionality are not present on the inspected inventory page.
automationApproach: Browser UI automation using Playwright/Selenium once search components are implemented and available in the application.
recommendations: Verify whether the product search requirement applies to the SauceDemo application or if this application lacks search by design.
Extend page discovery to any additional pages or sub-routes if search exists outside the inventory view.
assumptions: Assumed that the inspected pages represent the core product viewing area of the application.
